title: ESP Monsters
features: ESP to see all the monsters behind the walls 😐
script:
--[[

Orange - Boss
Red - Minions

]]

local enitity1 = game:GetService("Workspace")["ENTITY_1"]
local enitity2 = game:GetService("Workspace")["ENTITY_2"]
local enitity3 = game:GetService("Workspace")["ENTITY_3"]
local enitity4 = game:GetService("Workspace")["ENTITY_4"]

local esp = Instance.new("BoxHandleAdornment", enitity1)
esp.Adornee = enitity1
esp.ZIndex = 0
esp.Size = Vector3.new(2, 4, 2)
esp.Transparency = 0.35
esp.Color3 = Color3.fromRGB(222, 32, 32)
esp.AlwaysOnTop = true
local esp = Instance.new("BoxHandleAdornment", enitity3)
esp.Adornee = enitity3
esp.ZIndex = 0
esp.Size = Vector3.new(2, 4, 2)
esp.Transparency = 0.35
esp.Color3 = Color3.fromRGB(222, 32, 32)
esp.AlwaysOnTop = true
local esp = Instance.new("BoxHandleAdornment", enitity4)

esp.ZIndex = 0
esp.Size = Vector3.new(2, 4, 2)
esp.Transparency = 0.35

esp.AlwaysOnTop = true

local esp = Instance.new("BoxHandleAdornment", enitity2)
